'''Loell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]] together with her master [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tharsis]]. During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|liberation of Balmorra]] she was located by [[Balmorran resistance]] and then [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was searching for her master.
